title: 纽约大学与东京都知事签署意向书探讨在东京开设校区
body:
2026年7月14日，纽约大学与东京都知事小池百合子在纽约正式签署一份意向书。此次签约是双方在教育领域开展合作的重要环节，相关签约仪式在纽约当地举行。

根据协议披露的内容，该意向书的核心目的是探讨在东京开设纽约大学校区的可能性。双方将围绕在东京设立校区这一具体目标展开前期沟通与评估，旨在为双方未来的教育合作奠定坚实基础。

该协议的签署为纽约大学在东京设立校区提供了初步的合作框架。目前双方尚未公布具体的校区选址、建设规划以及后续的详细时间表。有关在东京开设校区的最终决定与具体进展，将基于此次意向书的探讨结果进一步落实。

# NYU, Tokyo governor ink pact for potential Japan campus

By KYOTA TANAKA/ Correspondent

July 15, 2026 at 17:41 JST

Photo/Illutration
Tokyo Governor Yuriko Koike signs a letter of intent with New York University in New York on July 14 to explore opening a campus in Tokyo. (Kyota Tanaka)

Photo/Illutration
Photo/Illutration [...] Photo/Illutration
Photo/Illutration

NEW YORK—Tokyo Governor Yuriko Koike signed an agreement with New York University here on July 14 to explore establishing a degree-granting campus in Tokyo, a potential major expansion for the prestigious U.S. university.

“We will advance our collaboration toward its realization while also gaining the cooperation of many related parties,” Koike told reporters.

Under the letter of intent, the two sides will formally study the creation of a full campus, according to the Tokyo metropolitan government.

Musashimurayama, a city in western Tokyo undergoing an extension of the Tama Toshi Monorail for future stations, has been floated as a potential site.

The agreement also includes plans to establish a hub for NYU’s existing study-abroad programs.
